lines: In Switzerland, owning one guinea pig is fucking illegal.
You can't own just one guinea pig there. They get lonely.
The Swiss care more about a rodent's feelings than yours, bitch.
The first speeding ticket, in 1896, was for eight miles an hour.
My grandma's walker goes faster than that shit.
A fluffy little cloud weighs about a million pounds.
That's a million pounds of water over your dumb ass.
Babies have about three hundred bones. Adults have two hundred six.
They fused together, you dumb bastard.
So where is one guinea pig illegal? Comment, dumbass.
